title: The Balanced Scorecard Achieving Performance Excellence
overview: The Balanced Scorecard, developed by Dr. Robert Kaplan (Harvard Business School) and Dr. David Norton, is a powerful tool for aligning business activities with the vision and strategy of an organization. In this hands-on course, participants will explore the core elements of the Balanced Scorecard, including vision, mission, goals, objectives, Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), targets, and initiatives. By the end of the course, participants will have the opportunity to apply a proven step-by-step model to build a Balanced Scorecard for a virtual company, equipping them with the knowledge and skills to develop or review a Balanced Scorecard for their department or organization.
audience: This course is designed for managers and supervisors involved in strategic planning and performance management. It is also highly beneficial for professionals focused on improving performance and measuring results.
methodology: The course utilizes a blend of interactive and practical approaches. In addition to brief presentations by the instructor and participants, the main focus will be on developing all elements of the Balanced Scorecard for a virtual company introduced on the first day. The course includes numerous group exercises to reinforce learning throughout the three days.
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: Explain the benefits and importance of a Strategy-Focused Organization (SFO)
Develop a SWOT analysis, vision and mission statements, and strategic goals for their organization or department
Use 'SMART' objectives and key performance indicators to track performance and productivity at all levels within their organizations
Apply best-in-class benchmarking techniques to set targets for each KPI
Design a Balanced Scorecard based on the Kaplan and Norton model
